title: Coexistence from First Principles
description: A layered reconstruction of Madhyasth Darshan's ontological core, activity-duration, order-relative stability, and knowledge-order cycles, with explicit boundaries between textual doctrine, formal organization, mathematical analogy, and open posits

title: From Unit Activity to Human Orderliness: A State-Dynamic Reconstruction of Coexistence
description: A source-bounded typed qualitative reconstruction linking intrinsic unit activity, compositional closure, T1 jeevan, animal and human joint forms, reflexive evaluation, and public orderliness. It distinguishes dharma and niyati-kram from causal forces, preserves composition and atomic development as separate lines, and keeps unresolved empirical mechanisms explicit.
